sources.label: Morphe android app patches (for apps that I use) - stable releases
sources.author: bearinmind
patch_list: Hide scrollbar option
Brings back the setting to hide the scroll bar.
Hide update badge
Removes the update red dot from the menu and Settings.
Remove address bar blur
Solid address and bottom bars instead of the blurred gradient.
Remove tab limit
Removes the 99-tab limit.
Remove telemetry
Stops Samsung's usage logs, analytics and crash reports, and keeps the app offline until its terms are accepted.
Theme color on bottom bar
The page's theme color also colors the bottom address bar and bottom bar.

sources.label: SBrowserX
sources.author: SBrowserX
patch_list: AMOLED Black & Bottom Bar Transparency Toggle
True frosted-glass bottom bar & toolbar translucency with adjustable transparency (15-85%), enhanced Chromium compositor blur, and AMOLED pure black (#000000) dark mode surfaces.
Auto-close unused tabs: After 1 day
Adds a native 'After 1 day' (24h) radio option directly inside Samsung's Auto-close unused tabs settings screen.
Block third-party cookies by default
Blocks third-party cookies by default across all sites on fresh installs, while allowing users to re-enable them in Settings.
Built-in Google Translate engine
Unlocks the Translate button in the side popup menu without Galaxy AI/SCS, routes page translation through Google Translate, and adds Chrome-style Translate settings.
Change package and app name
Changes the package name, custom permissions, provider authorities, internal content:// URIs, UriMatcher rules, and app display name so SBrowserX runs cleanly alongside stock Samsung Internet.
Disable Update Prompts & Badges
Blocks Galaxy Store and Google Play update checks, update banners, and update badges on the patched browser.
External downloader support
Forwards HTTP/HTTPS file downloads AND context-menu image/video/link downloads to external download managers (1DM, ADM, ABDM, FDM, Seal, etc.) via SBrowserX settings.
Remove 99-Tab Limit
Lifts Samsung Internet's 99-tab cap to 9999 tabs (configurable toggle in SBrowserX & Useful Features, enabled by default).
Remove telemetry, promotions & updates
Disables Samsung Analytics, SILog, SMP marketing push, Promotion Engine, Kindred shopping/coupons, and Galaxy Store update checks while preserving site Web Push notifications.
SBrowserX Settings, Extensions & Privacy Core
Adds SBrowserX settings hub and mirrors all toggles natively in-place across Samsung Internet's settings sections.
Unified Dark Mode, True AMOLED Websites & Vivid Images

Syncs website dark mode cleanly with browser Dark/Light mode (system or manual), eliminates Samsung NightDim & 50% dim veil, preserves true site colors/icons, and applies pure AMOLED #000000 backgrounds to darkened websites when AMOLED Bla…
Unlock Chrome Web Store & Extensions
Force-enables SIX extensions engine, unlocks extensions WebUI & Chrome Web Store, and prevents SixPkgUpdater from auto-uninstalling sideloaded CRX extensions on restart.
Unlock Compact Layout

Restores Samsung Internet's native Compact toolbar layout, fixes More-Menu height oscillation and Compact pill scroll/refresh jitter, and replaces the Galaxy AI button with a user-configurable button.
Unlock Debug settings menu
Always shows Samsung Internet's hidden Debug settings menu inside Settings.
